hard_profile_activation.activation_scope: this composed prompt and its render

scene: A visibly adult woman in a neat yet actively used compact living room is halfway through returning one blue paperback into its existing shelf gap. Other household elements make the reset visibly in progress.

randomized_details.return_target: gap between upright books on oak shelf
randomized_details.support_prop: glass of water on side table

review_policy.hard_result_rule: PASS only if every hard gate passes on the same saved image at its specified scales; FAIL if any hard gate fails; INDETERMINATE only if pixels cannot be obtained or inspected

scales.thumbnail: approximately 512 px longest side for composition and global relations
scales.native: full output resolution for contact, shelf gap, and small prop evidence

hard_visual_gates.positive_pixel_gate: The adult woman visibly guides one blue paperback halfway into an existing gap between upright books on the oak shelf, with book, target, and hand contact readable together.
confusion_targets: book merely held beside the shelf
book already fully stored with no active return
book being handed to another person

hard_visual_gates.positive_pixel_gate: A broad sideboard work surface is visibly recently cleared, retaining a subtle localized book-sized patch while the surrounding lived-in room remains coherent.
confusion_targets: featureless showroom with no trace of use
bare wall mistaken for work surface
patch only asserted by prompt but absent in pixels

hard_visual_gates.positive_pixel_gate: A half-folded throw on the sofa arm near the cleared sideboard is visibly awaiting the next tidy motion while the book return is in progress.
confusion_targets: random decorative blanket unrelated to a remaining task
throw hidden or too small to inspect

hard_visual_gates.positive_pixel_gate: A continuous open strip of floor connects the bookcase activity area with the sofa and broader room, allowing a clear walking route.
confusion_targets: furniture or clutter blocks the route
isolated floor patch with no connection
room is empty showroom rather than actively used home

embodiment_hard_gates.positive_pixel_gate: The acting hands visibly belong to the woman and no crucial hand is duplicated or detached.
Her arm connection and reach to the target shelf are physically coherent.
Her standing support agrees with the weight of the light book and the visible body position.
Hand-to-book and book-to-shelf-gap contact are physically coherent with adequate space.
The camera view makes the critical book return relation assessable.

supplemental_observations: visible adult appearance guidance from supplied portrait is assessed without identity assertion
neat but used living room, glass, pleated lamp, and plant are recorded separately from the hard relation gates
